failure_summary.description: Searched for hotels even though the user requested only flights; describing a family vacation did not request lodging.
Treated the return date as an outbound arrival-date constraint instead of searching a separate return flight.
Reformatted user-provided dates and imported a library despite explicit instructions not to do so.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly prohibits inferring unrequested domains, requires separate flight searches for date ranges, preserves user-provided date strings, and forbids imports. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing rules rather than a gap to patch.
